clue.text: Introduce girl to mysterious rite involving incense

indicators.note: involving means the scrambled letters wrap around the girl's name
mysterious suggests the letters of rite are jumbled into a puzzling order

parts.note: Rita is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone initiates a young woman into a strange ceremony with smoking incense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mysterious' rearranges RITE to IRTE, and 'involving' puts RITA inside it: IR-RITA-TE. 'Introduce' and 'to' are link words. 'incense' is the verb, to anger, not the perfume.
explanation.definitionFit: To incense someone is to make them angry, and to irritate is to annoy: near synonyms as verbs.

clue.text: Rates at which the sea comes up on board

indicators.note: on, read with board, means placed inside the letters for a ship

parts.note: SS (steamship) brackets things that are on board in crosswords

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: the deep is a poetic name for the sea

explanation.surface: A question about how fast seawater washes up over a ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' turns DEEP into PEED, which goes inside SS, the steamship convention for 'on board'.
explanation.definitionFit: Speeds are rates of travel, the distance covered in a given time.

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of the next word are set out in a different order

explanation.surface: An odd financial philosophy that lets you pay later.
explanation.definitionFit: Buying on credit means the payment is put off until later.

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level
issue means offspring, such as a son

explanation.surface: A routine handout given to a government minister.
explanation.definitionFit: A parson is a member of the clergy, a minister of the church.

definitions.meaning: leftover bits of food thrown to the dog

explanation.surface: Brawls that dogs relish taking part in.
explanation.definitionFit: Scraps are both minor fights and leftover morsels fed to pets.

definitions.meaning: to accompany a woman as her attendant

explanation.surface: A man and a woman arrive together as an escorted couple.
explanation.definitionFit: To act as a lady's gallant attendant is to squire her, and a country landowner is a squire.

clue.text: They join the family after the match

definitions.text: They join the family after the match

parts.words: They join the family after the match
parts.note: the match is a wedding, not a sporting fixture: a spouse's relatives become family by marriage

explanation.surface: New members welcomed into the family after a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Relatives by marriage become part of the family once the wedding has taken place.

parts.note: the main is the open sea, so a road across it is a shipping channel

explanation.definitionFit: A seaway is a route for shipping across the ocean, which crosswords call the main.

parts.note: 5 across gives fights, so someone looking for fights is spoiling for a scrap

explanation.definitionFit: A warlike, aggressive person is the type always seeking a fight.

indicators.note: turns means the following short word is flipped round

parts.note: mice are household vermin

explanation.surface: A cleaner finds rats and mice in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' makes PU from UP. The surface has the cleaner as a person; the definition means a scouring stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Pumice is a light volcanic stone used to scrub away hard skin and stains.

clue.text: Possibly uncrates something coming from ancient Italy

indicators.note: possibly hints that the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Unpacked crates might contain relics from ancient Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: The Etruscans were a people of ancient Italy before Rome, and the word describes their artefacts.

indicators.note: retrospective means looking backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: an air is a tune or melody

explanation.surface: A song accompanied by a nostalgic tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retrospective' turns AIR into RIA, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song in an opera.

clue.text: One doesn't have to practise it

definitions.text: One doesn't have to practise it

parts.words: One doesn't have to practise it
parts.note: read as going without, one who abstains from having things exercises this virtue, not someone excused from rehearsal

explanation.surface: Something nobody is obliged to rehearse.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-denial is the habit of going without the things one wants.

clue.text: Saint George shocked by such discrimination

indicators.note: shocked suggests the letters of the name are thrown into disarray

explanation.surface: England's patron saint is appalled by a kind of prejudice.
explanation.definitionFit: Segregation is the enforced separation of groups, a form of discrimination.

clue.text: Rakes money in with comedian's material

indicators.note: in tells us the money is placed inside the word for rakes

parts.note: a roue is a rake, a dissolute man
tin is slang for money

explanation.surface: Playboys make a fortune using a comic's jokes.
explanation.walkthrough: A rake here is a debauchee, not a garden tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A comedian's routines are the rehearsed acts or sets of jokes performed on stage.

definitions.meaning: busy, as a toilet or telephone line

explanation.surface: Someone lived together with a partner while betrothed.
explanation.definitionFit: Occupied describes a home that is inhabited and a person or line that is busy.

definitions.meaning: Long John is the pirate in Treasure Island
second place in a race wins a medal of this metal

explanation.surface: A buccaneer is awarded a decoration.
explanation.definitionFit: Long John of Treasure Island bears this surname, and second place earns a medal of this metal.

clue.text: A lever used to take the lid off

indicators.note: used suggests the letters are put to work in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone prises open a box with a crowbar.
explanation.definitionFit: To expose or disclose something is figuratively to remove its cover.

clue.text: Expert swimmers in the Household Brigade?

definitions.meaning: people trained to rescue bathers at a pool or beach
a cavalry regiment of the British sovereign's household troops

explanation.surface: Are the royal soldiers also good at swimming?
explanation.definitionFit: Beach rescuers bear this name, as does a senior regiment guarding the British monarch.

indicators.note: in places the turned sailor within the word for time

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so read in reverse

parts.note: tar is a traditional word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman is annoyed by a series of blunders in his era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns TAR into RAT, which goes inside ERA.
explanation.definitionFit: Errata are a list of errors found in a printed book.

clue.text: He may challenge you for record after slow start

indicators.note: after sends the record second, behind the opening letter of slow
start picks out the opening letter of slow

parts.note: an entry is an item written in a record or log

explanation.surface: Someone may dispute your record because you began slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentry is a guard who calls out 'Who goes there?' to anyone approaching.

parts.note: a very short haircut, and the word alone also means a ship's company

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's company of sailors goes by this word, which also names a short haircut.

parts.note: a version is a particular form of something

explanation.surface: A specific type of distaste.
explanation.definitionFit: An aversion is a strong dislike or disinclination.

clue.text: Male relative gets a quarter — what a relief!

parts.note: northeast is one quarter or point of the compass, abbreviated NE
phew is the exclamation of relief

explanation.surface: A boy in the family receives a quarter of something and sighs with relief.
explanation.definitionFit: A nephew is the son of one's brother or sister.

definitions.meaning: A riding track in London's Hyde Park

explanation.surface: A quarrel in the park is a nasty affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel but is a track: Rotten Row is a famous bridleway in Hyde Park, London.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hyde Park bridleway is named Rotten Row, and the word also means nasty or decayed.

indicators.note: before puts gold ahead of the transaction

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
a deal is a business transaction

explanation.surface: Assaying gold before a sale.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a severe trial or testing experience.
